tasks.label: Nodra: validar contratos CI/CD em container
tasks.command: podman run --rm --user 0:0 --entrypoint pwsh --volume "$PWD:/workspace:ro,Z" --workdir /workspace docker.io/lzocateli/dotnet-sdk:10.0.403-noble-v1 -NoProfile -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; & ./tools/scripts/test-cicd-contracts.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & ./tools/scripts/ci/Test-ManagedFiles.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & ./tools/scripts/validate-repository.ps1' && podman run --rm --volume "$PWD:/repo:ro,Z" --workdir /repo docker.io/rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12

tasks.label: Nodra: verificar builds e pre-requisitos
tasks.command: podman run --rm --user 0:0 --entrypoint pwsh --volume "$PWD:/workspace:ro,Z" --workdir /workspace docker.io/lzocateli/dotnet-sdk:10.0.403-noble-v1 -NoProfile -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; foreach ($name in @("test-cicd-contracts", "convert-release-manifest", "validate-release-images")) { & pwsh -NoProfile -File "tools/scripts/$name.ps1" --help | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Ajuda falhou: $name" }; Write-Output "--help aprovado: $name" }; & ./.specify/scripts/powershell/check-prerequisites.ps1 -Json -RequireSpec -RequireTasks -IncludeTasks; & ./tools/scripts/ci/Test-ManagedFiles.ps1 -Components ci,release,release-preview,publish-containers,publish-github-assets,deploy,dependency-updates,repository-policy' && podman image inspect nodra-api:011-rc-validation nodra-bff:011-rc-validation nodra-worker:011-rc-validation --format '{{.RepoTags}} {{json .Config.Labels}}' && tail -n 8 /tmp/nodra-011-web-build-20261111-1615.log
